def cli_update(ctx):
    """Update Apio."""
    import requests
    import semver
    from apio.core.utils import get_version
    from apio.core.config import get_config

    config = get_config()
    version = get_version()
    latest_version = requests.get(
        'https://pypi.python.org/pypi/apio/json'
    ).json()['info']['version']

    if semver.compare(version, latest_version) == -1:
        ctx.log(
            'Updating Apio from {} to {}'.format(version, latest_version)
        )
        ctx.run(config.get('update_command'))
    else:
        ctx.log(
            'You are using the latest version of Apio: {}'.format(version)
        )
